requests.question: MI-262 criterion (2) — "a tree that is behind reads as behind" — CANNOT be met the way it is written, and it has been open since 2026-09-10. Establishing that the VM is behind GITHUB requires a fetch, and GET /api/bot/work/checklist deliberately performs none: fetching on an API request path is the wedge class this repo has paid for twice. Do you want the fetch moved OFF the request path, or the criterion retired as a recorded decision?

options.label: Retire criterion (2) — the provenance half is the answer
options.implication: RECOMMENDED. Records that "behind GitHub" is answered by the age of the last fetch rather than by a commit count, which is what #11716 already delivers and what is already rendering. Costs nothing, ships nothing, and MI-262 can then close on criterion (1) alone — which IS observed. ⚠️ The accepted residual: the page can tell you it has not looked recently, and can never tell you how far behind it is. A VM fetching on schedule but failing to pull would read fresh.

options.label: Move the fetch off the request path (a timer writes a receipt)
options.implication: Tier-2. A systemd timer on the live VM does `git fetch` on its own clock and writes a receipt the route READS — no network on the request path, and the page can then state a real behind-count. ⚠️ Buys a new failure mode this page currently does not have: a timer that stops firing. CLAUDE.md records that scheduled carriers here fire late or skip days (probes +4h53m, work-digest 5 firings against 24 declared), so the receipt needs its own staleness grade or it becomes the frozen-board failure one level down.

options.label: Have ict-git-sync write the receipt it already knows
options.implication: Tier-2, and cheaper than a new timer because ict-git-sync ALREADY fetches every ~5 minutes — it is the one carrier measured to work here. It would stamp what it saw; the route reads the stamp. ⚠️ I have NOT read that unit's script this session, so whether it can cheaply emit a behind-count is UNVERIFIED — do not read this option as costed.

requests.context: WHAT IS ALREADY TRUE, so this is not re-asking something answered. #11716 (5f5292a0f) shipped the PROVENANCE half and it is OBSERVED on the deployed route: treeNote now reads "level with the local origin/main ref AS OF THE LAST FETCH <n>m ago (FETCH_HEAD mtime); this never fetches, so main may have moved since", and mainRefAgeHours is None — never 0.0 — when we cannot establish when we last fetched. So `synced` already justifies itself and a VM that STOPPED fetching announces itself through a growing mainRefAgeHours. What is NOT true is the literal criterion: behind_commits counts against the LOCAL origin/main ref, and scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh does `git fetch` then `git reset --hard origin/main`, so on the live VM that equality holds BY CONSTRUCTION — the zero is guaranteed, not measured. ⚠️ I am NOT proposing to fetch on the request path under any option; that is off the table for the reason above and is not one of the choices.
